name: safety-governance
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when trust-ladder / budget enforcement moves into a different layer than a project-local central config (config.json) consulted at tick entry, or when the config schema reaches its next breaking major (3.0.0).
spec_change_reason: Phase 2 (writer-only; config SCHEMA UNCHANGED at 2.7.0): expand the configure WRITER + the /auto-maintainer:configure --setup skill into a full guided onboarding. configure.py gains --features-root (MAY be absolute), --work-own-filings (bool), --issue-labels (issue_filter.labels DNF: comma=AND, semicolon=OR), --issue-title-pattern (regex), all validated for issue_filter THROUGH this feature's issue_filter normalizer (writer owns no validation the reader does not; invalid -> non-zero exit, no partial write); a read-only --preflight probe emitting {gh_authenticated, gh_account, resolved_repo, config_exists}; and a --describe catalog that now carries a loop-'stage' per knob, ordered PULL->IMPLEMENT->VERIFY->GATE->SCHEDULING->SAFETY. The configure SKILL.md (via skill-creator) is rewritten into the 5-step guided --setup onboarding (preflight+confirm-repo -> stage-by-stage from --describe -> opt-in route -> one-shot apply+--show -> offer /start), deriving all knobs/prose/stage/repo+auth from --describe/--preflight and dispatching no subagent. spec.md already carried the Phase 2 surface (committed d04d763); this cycle implements code+tests and raises the housekeep doc-baseline floor 351->411 for the legitimate spec growth.
